description: List the MCP servers from OnlyMCP's catalogue, the ones an account can add with one click and then reach through its single address. Meant for checking whether a service such as GitHub or Notion can be connected and how it signs in; not for calling those servers, which only a signed-in account can do. Answers one line per server with its name, address, sign-in method and the prefix its tools get, up to 60 lines. Any other MCP server with an http address can be added by hand and is not listed here.

query.description: Part of a server name or address to filter by, for example "git". Left out: the whole catalogue.

name: list_servers
title: List connectable MCP servers
